# Build games with LuaJIT

> Typed entity component system and game engine for Lua.

Tecs is a typed entity component system for LuaJIT and the game engine built around it, written in Teal. The ECS knows what the GPU reads, so rendering is not a layer bolted on top of a renderer-agnostic core. SDL owns the loop: an entry file returns an application and a C host drives it.

## Table of Contents

### Introduction

- [Getting started](/getting-started.md): Build the engine, write an entry file that returns an application, and register a game as one plugin
- [Modules](/modules.md): Every module a game can reach, spelled the way a game writes it, each linking to its page

### CLI

- [Tecs CLI](/cli.md): The planned tecs command line tool: its commands, what a project is, and what it will not do
- [Projects](/cli/projects.md): What the tecs command treats as a project: the tecs.lua manifest, its fields, and how the entry file is found
- [Scope](/cli/scope.md): What the tecs command deliberately will not do, and how its offline reference shares one content tree with this site

### Modules

- [Modules](/modules.md): Every module a game can reach, spelled the way a game writes it, each linking to its page
- [Modules](/modules.md): Every module a game can reach, spelled the way a game writes it, each linking to its page
- [tecs.application.Application](/modules/application.md): The application object an entry file returns and the host drives: its config, what it owns, and the frame
- [tecs.assets](/modules/assets.md): Asynchronous image and sound loading on a worker thread, with handles, batches and explicit release
- [tecs.audio](/modules/audio.md): Sound: clips, voices, groups, keyed limits, fades, pitch, loop points, streaming, the Sound component, and the devices underneath
- [tecs.box2d](/modules/box2d.md): Entity-first Box2D 3 rigid bodies, colliders, queries, contacts, and sensors
- [tecs.data](/modules/data.md): Turning bytes into other bytes: JSON in both directions, DEFLATE in both directions, and a hash over either
- [tecs.events](/modules/events.md): The engine's typed platform event stream: one wide record per event, one ECS event type per kind, and how to observe, copy and inject them
- [tecs.future.Future](/modules/future.md): A value that settles once: four states, combinators, a source-driven wait, counted cancellation and the sequence bridge
- [tecs.input](/modules/input.md): Gameplay input in three tiers behind a layer stack, the gamepads attached to it, and the standalone sensors a device carries
- [tecs.log](/modules/log.md): SDL's logging behind a Lua-side guard: named loggers mapped to SDL categories, priorities SDL owns, and a JSON Lines file
- [tecs.mcp](/modules/mcp.md): The debug server: JSON-RPC over HTTP answered inside the frame, the tools every build exposes, the sandbox and the transport
- [tecs.sequence](/modules/sequence.md): Deterministic, snapshot-safe sequencing: compiled programs, playback handles, three clocks, and the tween timelines that run on the same runtime
- [tecs.system](/modules/system.md): The operating system asked directly: what this build can do here, the clipboard, running another program, URLs, locales, power and native dialogs
- [tecs.time](/modules/time.md): Frame timing with a monotonic counter, a clamped delta, and an injectable provider for deterministic replay
- [tecs.window.Window](/modules/window.md): Creating an OS window and reading its size, state, confinement and displays, in screen coordinates and pixels
- [tecs.workers](/modules/workers.md): Worker threads and serialized channels: spawning a state of its own, what can cross between them, and how a worker is asked to stop

#### tecs.filesystem

- [tecs.filesystem](/modules/filesystem.md): Where a game may read and write, what to do with a path once you have one, and the watcher that reports when a file changed
- [tecs.filesystem.watch](/modules/filesystem/watch.md): Polling the files this process loaded so an edit drives a reload, with settle rules for half-written saves

#### tecs.gfx

- [tecs.gfx](/modules/gfx.md): Drawing: the camera, the render components, the renderer, text, and the vocabularies a scene is described in
- [tecs.gfx.animation](/modules/gfx/animation.md): Sprite sheets and the playback that reads them: frames, tags, slices and pivots, the Animation component, and where a frame is resolved
- [tecs.gfx.layers](/modules/gfx/layers.md): Layer bands, the depth they resolve to, and what a layer does to its contents: sorting, positioning, parallax and lighting
- [tecs.gfx.materials](/modules/gfx/materials.md): How a material is authored, how a name becomes an id, and the module that reads materials and publishes the dispatch
- [tecs.gfx.particles](/modules/gfx/particles.md): GPU-simulated particle emitters: effects, curves and gradients, the ParticleEmitter component, and the pool plugin

#### tecs.net

- [tecs.net](/modules/net.md): Nonblocking TCP streams and UDP datagrams, with asynchronous hostname resolution and connection
- [tecs.net.http](/modules/net/http.md): An HTTP client where every request is a future, every body is a stream, and nothing goes in the frame loop

### tecs.ecs

- [tecs.ecs](/ecs.md): Tour of the ECS half of Tecs: worlds, entities, components, systems, plugins, queries, archetypes, phases and resources
- [Archetypes](/ecs/archetype.md): Archetype storage groups with row and column layout, get and getMut column access, set, relationship lookups, dirty tracking, and lifecycle observers
- [Builtins](/ecs/builtins.md): The components, relationship, events and systems every world registers automatically, all on tecs.ecs
- [Events](/ecs/events.md): Address-based ECS events: observe, emit, hasObservers, newEvent, newFFIEvent, and the MessageBus router
- [Mutation model](/ecs/mutation-model.md): Normative specification of instant versus staged mutation paths, entity lifecycle states, commit drain ordering, and visibility guarantees
- [Phases](/ecs/phases.md): Game-loop phase groups, what the engine runs in each, and the enablePhase, disablePhase, registerPhase, and runPhase world methods
- [Plugins](/ecs/plugins.md): Plugins are the one way into a world: what the entry plugin is handed, how to compose plugins, and the patterns that scale
- [Profiling](/ecs/profiling.md): LuaJIT sampling profiler and trace-abort tracker through tecs.utils.profile
- [tecs.ecs.random](/ecs/random.md): Seeded generation in named, independent streams a snapshot carries, plus standalone generators and Perlin noise
- [Save games](/ecs/save-games.md): Snapshot save and load with saveSnapshot, loadSnapshot, transient components, snapshot handlers, filtering, and the binary format spec
- [State stack](/ecs/states.md): The world's state stack: createState, pushState, popState, peekState, lifecycle policies, auto-tagging, and transition events
- [Systems](/ecs/systems.md): Adding and removing systems, the SystemConfig shape, ordering with before and after, and the tecs.ecs.runif predicates
- [World](/ecs/world.md): Core World API for entities, spawn and despawn, batch operations, deferred scopes, resources, plugins, phases, and stats

#### Components

- [Components](/ecs/components.md): Component overview with world get, getMut, set, remove, has, requires, and transient
- [Component Bundles](/ecs/components/bundles.md): Reusable entity-spawning templates via world:newBundle, spawnBundle, and required-plus-with component definitions
- [Component Construction](/ecs/components/construction.md): Shared component construction model covering __call, new, fields, defaults, and the init hook
- [Dirty Tracking](/ecs/components/dirty-tracking.md): Per-archetype per-component dirty bits set by getMut and set, and the extractor that reads them
- [FFI Components](/ecs/components/ffi.md): FFI struct-backed components via newFFIComponent with C field types and defaults
- [Scalar Components](/ecs/components/scalar-components.md): Single-value number, boolean, or string components via newScalarComponent with fast SoA columns
- [Component Serialization](/ecs/components/serialization.md): Component serialize and deserialize hooks, transient, and automatic FFI schema fingerprint migration
- [Table Components](/ecs/components/table-components.md): Lua-table-backed components via newComponent with fields, init, custom __call, and new
- [Tag Components](/ecs/components/tag-components.md): Dataless presence tags via newTagComponent for flags, markers, and query filtering

#### Queries

- [Queries](/ecs/queries.md): Creating and iterating queries with include, exclude, includeAny, temp, cursors, and deferred mutations
- [Query callbacks](/ecs/queries/callbacks.md): Batch onEntitiesAdded and onEntitiesRemoved query hooks with row ranges and deferred-drain semantics
- [Query grouping](/ecs/queries/grouping.md): Grouping matching archetypes by integer key with groupBy, groups, group, getGroup, and getGroupCount

#### Relationships

- [Relationships](/ecs/relationships.md): Directed entity relationships via newRelationship with exclusive, sparse, cascadeDelete, and traversal APIs
- [FFI Relationships](/ecs/relationships/ffi.md): FFI struct-backed relationships via newFFIRelationship with packed field types and target semantics
